The Systems Biology Intern will support the Systems Toxicology team by preparing samples, performing spatial experiments, analyzing spatial genomics datasets, and expanding analytical workflows for drug safety investigations.

Responsibilities
The Systems Biology Intern will work within the Systems Toxicology team to generate and analyze cutting-edge spatial genomics datasets in order to advance investigative assessments into the molecular mechanisms of drug-induced toxicities
Responsibilities will include sample preparation and performing spatial experiments, expanding analytical capabilities/workflows for spatial data and analysis of newly generated datasets from investigative studies

Required
* Candidates should currently be enrolled in a minimum of a BS/BA in: Computer Science, Informatics, Data science, Biology, Chemistry, Toxicology, or related discipline
* Must be available for a period of 10-12 weeks, beginning June 2026
Preferred
* G.P.A of 3.0 or higher
* Strong analytical and communication skills
* Laboratory experience such as tissue sectioning using a microtome and/or cryostat, RNA isolation, and other molecular biology techniques
* Experience with analysis of transcriptomics data analysis using RStudio and/or Python
* Bash scripting via the terminal
* Familiarity with data architecture and engineering
Benefits
Great development and a chance to see if we are the right company for your long-term goals
Opportunity to collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues while developing and expanding your career
